Build a career with Collins Aerospace
Empowering veterans in technology
Join us at the forefront of cutting-edge technology in connected battlespace, autonomous systems, aircraft electrification, and cybersecurity, all focused on ensuring the safety of our service members. Our roles help veterans find a great fit for their skills, we can build a safer future together.
Discover more
Launching careers for new talent
Explore internships and co-op programs designed to offer emerging professionals hands-on experience in the dynamic aerospace and defense industry. By joining us, you'll not only gain invaluable real-world experience but also set the stage for a meaningful and impactful career. 
Discover more
Engineering the future with innovation
Embark on a journey to work on groundbreaking, mission-critical projects that redefine the limits of technology. An engineering career with us means being at the forefront of innovation. If you're eager to tackle complex challenges—many of which have yet to be solved—Collins Aerospace is the perfect place for you.
Discover more
Driving innovation in digital technology
From reducing flight delays worldwide through cutting-edge digital technologies to pioneering the next generation of hybrid aircraft, you’ll play a vital role in shaping the future of aviation. Along the way, you’ll build a meaningful career where you can grow, thrive, and most importantly, help define what’s possible in the skies above.
Discover more
Production careers powering today's flights
Production professionals at Collins Aerospace are powering today's flights and tomorrow's endeavors. We create solutions to reach new heights in aviation. From developing safer more comfortable air travel to being a world leader in nacelle technologies, we're making modern flight possible fore millions of travelers and military personnel.

Tuition assistance

The Employee Scholar Program offers educational benefits starting from day one, providing assistance with tuition for approved courses or degree programs. This program is designed to help you advance your education and grow in your career.

Community involvement

Our strategic community initiatives and dedicated employee volunteerism are making a tangible impact in communities globally. Together, we're driving measurable positive change around the world.

Health and wellness

Our comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans encompass both preventive and non-routine care. We also contribute to your health savings account, depending on eligibility, and our wellness program rewards you for making healthy lifestyle choices.

Onsite benefits

Many of our facilities feature onsite health and wellness services, electric vehicle charging stations, cafeterias, gym facilities, and more. These amenities are designed to enhance your work experience and support a balanced lifestyle.

Professional development

We offer internal programs such as Operations Leadership Development Program and Leadership Development Program that help cultivate the next generation of leaders who will shape the future of aerospace and defense. 

Global exposure

Our growth-oriented culture is backed by supportive leaders who provide numerous opportunities for professional development. You'll have the chance to collaborate with colleagues from around the globe and advance your career under RTX.

Collins Fellows Program

An elite program to recognize the experts who shape the future of our company and the industry. Our fellows foster technical excellence by servicing as leaders, innovators, technical experts and mentors.

Travel opportunities

When opportunities arise, you'll have the chance to travel to various facilities and participate in programs around the globe. This global exposure will enrich your professional experience and broaden your horizons.

Our strategic business units
Advanced Structures
Our Advanced Structures team ensures structural integrity of aircraft and helicopters, helps platforms take off and land, move forward, transport cargo, and conduct rescues so air travel can be safer, more efficient, and more sustainable in the years to come.
Avionics
Our Avionics team advances aviation electronics and information management solutions, ensuring that commercial and military customers worldwide can safely reach their destinations while staying connected and informed. By leveraging top-tier networks, connectivity, and data/analytics, we tackle significant challenges, enhancing security and connectivity on and off the aircraft.
Interiors
Our Interiors team is focused on innovation, safety and cost efficiency. As a leader in aviation interior products and services, we’re helping airlines and original equipment manufacturers create a positive experience for their customers.
Mission Systems
Our Mission Systems team helps civilian, military and government customers complete their most complex missions. Our customers depend on us for intelligent and secure communications, missionized systems for specialized aircraft and spacecraft, and collaborative space solutions.
Power and Controls
Our major products from the Power and Controls team are on-board virtually every aircraft flying – from emergency power generation systems that keep passengers safe to reliable cabin pressure controls and quieter engines that create a positive in-flight experience.
